title: "Profile clusters, everyone pooled"

Which proteins relate to the phenotype in the same way? Two groupings, with no group label:

- Profiles: each protein is described by its limma t against every trait in every window (the
  change scores of `01_Trait_Associations`), and proteins with similar profiles are clustered.
- Per trait: for each trait's training change and T1 level, the proteins at p < 0.05 are grouped
  by how they co-vary across people, with each group's direction and main module.

Each group is described by its most over-represented gene set (clusterProfiler's `enricher()`),
with every protein tested in the window as the universe. The groups come from the same t values
they summarise, so these descriptions are not tests of the grouping; the mean silhouette reports
how separate the groups are.

## Packages

dynamicTreeCut cuts the trees and clusterProfiler runs the enrichment; both are called with `::`.

```{r}
#| label: packages
#| message: false
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
source(here("00_Setup", "Shared_functions", "workbooks.R"))
source(here("02_HRvLR", "helpers.R"))
inputs <- c(
  corrected = "01_Processing/03_Blood_Correction/c_data/proteins_corrected.rds",
  associations = "03_Continuous/01_Trait_Associations/c_data/associations.rds",
  gene_sets = "01_Processing/04_Gene_Sets/c_data/gene_sets.rds",
  modules = "01_Processing/06_Module_Building/c_data/modules.rds"
)
paths <- vapply(inputs, here, character(1))
stopifnot(file.exists(paths))
```

## Input

The blood-corrected matrix, the protein change scores, the gene sets and each protein's module.

```{r}
#| label: input
corrected <- readRDS(paths[["corrected"]])
meta <- as_tibble(corrected$targets)
gs <- readRDS(paths[["gene_sets"]])
modules <- readRDS(paths[["modules"]])
gene_of <- with(filter(gs$protein_map, selected), set_names(gene, uniprot_id))
protein_label <- set_names(sub(";.*", "", corrected$genes$Genes), rownames(corrected))
set_label <- with(gs$set_catalog, set_names(pathway, set_id))
module_of <- with(modules$membership, set_names(module, uniprot_id))
observed_t <- readRDS(paths[["associations"]])$change_score |>
  filter(feature_type == "proteins") |>
  select(window, trait, feature, t, p)
term2gene <- tibble(set_id = rep(names(gs$sets), lengths(gs$sets)), gene = unlist(gs$sets))
count(observed_t, window, name = "protein_trait_pairs")
```

## Three helpers

`tree_groups()` takes a protein-by-column matrix and a minimum group size, clusters proteins by
average linkage on 1 − Pearson r, and cuts the tree with `dynamicTreeCut::cutreeDynamic()`, which
finds branches by shape instead of at one height. Proteins it leaves unassigned (group 0) are
dropped. It returns each protein's group and the mean silhouette (how much closer proteins sit to
their own group than to the next, −1 to 1).

```{r}
#| label: tree-groups
tree_groups <- function(m, min_size) {
  d <- as.dist(1 - cor(t(m)))
  groups <- dynamicTreeCut::cutreeDynamic(hclust(d, "average"),
    distM = as.matrix(d), minClusterSize = min_size, deepSplit = 2, verbose = 0
  )
  kept <- groups != 0
  silhouette_mean <- if (n_distinct(groups[kept]) < 2) {
    NA_real_
  } else {
    mean(cluster::silhouette(groups[kept], as.dist(as.matrix(d)[kept, kept]))[, "sil_width"])
  }
  list(groups = set_names(groups, rownames(m))[kept], silhouette = silhouette_mean)
}
```

`describe()` takes a group's proteins and the universe they came from, and returns the most
over-represented gene set with its p and FDR (across all sets tested for that group).

```{r}
#| label: describe
describe <- function(members, universe) {
  res <- clusterProfiler::enricher(na.omit(unname(gene_of[members])),
    universe = na.omit(unname(gene_of[universe])), TERM2GENE = term2gene, minGSSize = 15,
    maxGSSize = 500, pvalueCutoff = 1, qvalueCutoff = 1
  )
  if (is.null(res) || nrow(res@result) == 0) {
    return(tibble(top_set = NA_character_, top_set_p = NA_real_, top_set_fdr = NA_real_))
  }
  top <- slice_min(as_tibble(res@result), pvalue, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
  tibble(top_set = unname(set_label[top$ID]), top_set_p = top$pvalue, top_set_fdr = top$p.adjust)
}
```

`summarise_groups()` takes each protein's group and t, and returns one row per group: size, mean t,
share moving up, main module, the 15 proteins with the largest |t|, and `describe()`'s top set.

```{r}
#| label: summarise-groups
summarise_groups <- function(groups, t, universe) {
  tibble(feature = names(groups), group = groups, t = t[names(groups)]) |>
    summarise(
      n_proteins = n(), mean_t = mean(t), share_positive = mean(t > 0), members = list(feature),
      main_module = names(which.max(table(module_of[feature]))),
      proteins = paste(head(protein_label[feature][order(-abs(t))], 15), collapse = ", "),
      .by = group
    ) |>
    mutate(enrichment = map(members, \(m) describe(m, universe))) |>
    unnest(enrichment) |>
    select(-members) |>
    arrange(group)
}
```

## Association profiles

Each protein's row holds its t against every window-and-trait screen.

```{r}
#| label: profiles
profiles <- observed_t |>
  transmute(feature, screen = paste(window, trait), t) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = screen, values_from = t) |>
  column_to_rownames("feature") |>
  as.matrix()
stopifnot(!anyNA(profiles))
profile_cut <- tree_groups(profiles, min_size = 20)
profile_summary <- summarise_groups(profile_cut$groups, rowMeans(profiles), rownames(profiles))
profile_means <- as_tibble(profiles[names(profile_cut$groups), ], rownames = "feature") |>
  mutate(group = profile_cut$groups) |>
  pivot_longer(-c(feature, group), names_to = "screen", values_to = "t") |>
  summarise(mean_t = mean(t), .by = c(group, screen))
c(
  proteins = nrow(profiles), screens = ncol(profiles), groups = n_distinct(profile_cut$groups),
  silhouette = round(profile_cut$silhouette, 3)
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-profiles
#| fig-cap: "Mean limma t per profile group and screen."
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 6
ggplot(profile_means, aes(screen, factor(group), fill = mean_t)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", high = "#B2182B", name = "mean t") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "profile group") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1))
```

## Co-variation groups per trait

For the training and T1-level windows, each trait's p < 0.05 proteins are clustered on their values
across people (training change, or T1 level), at least 8 proteins to a group. The universe for the
enrichment is every protein tested in that window.

```{r}
#| label: trait-groups
matrix_of <- list(
  training = person_values(corrected$E, meta, "T2", from = "T1"),
  baseline_level = person_values(corrected$E, meta, "T1")
)
trait_groups <- observed_t |>
  filter(window %in% names(matrix_of), p < 0.05) |>
  nest(.by = c(window, trait)) |>
  mutate(result = map2(window, data, \(w, hits) {
    cut <- tree_groups(matrix_of[[w]][hits$feature, , drop = FALSE], min_size = 8)
    universe <- filter(observed_t, window == w)$feature
    summarise_groups(cut$groups, set_names(hits$t, hits$feature), universe) |>
      mutate(silhouette = cut$silhouette, n_hits = nrow(hits))
  })) |>
  select(-data) |>
  unnest(result)
count(trait_groups, window, trait, name = "groups")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-trait-groups
#| fig-cap: "Co-variation groups among each trait's p < 0.05 proteins; fill: the group's mean t."
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6
ggplot(trait_groups, aes(n_proteins, paste(window, trait), fill = mean_t)) +
  geom_col(position = position_stack(), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", high = "#B2182B", name = "mean t") +
  labs(x = "proteins", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 8)
```

## Validation

```{r}
#| label: validate
stopifnot(
  all(names(profile_cut$groups) %in% rownames(profiles)),
  sum(profile_summary$n_proteins) == length(profile_cut$groups),
  all(trait_groups$n_proteins >= 8), all(trait_groups$n_proteins <= trait_groups$n_hits)
)
```

## Summary

`r n_distinct(profile_cut$groups)` profile groups hold `r length(profile_cut$groups)` of
`r nrow(profiles)` proteins (mean silhouette `r round(profile_cut$silhouette, 2)`); the largest
holds `r max(profile_summary$n_proteins)`. `r nrow(trait_groups)` co-variation groups over
`r nrow(distinct(trait_groups, window, trait))` trait and window pairs.

## Save

`profile_clusters.rds` holds the profile groups and the per-trait groups for the figures.

```{r}
#| label: save
out <- here("03_Continuous", "03_Profile_Clusters", "c_data")
dir.create(out, showWarnings = FALSE)
profile_members <- tibble(
  feature = names(profile_cut$groups), label = unname(protein_label[names(profile_cut$groups)]),
  group = profile_cut$groups
)
saveRDS(
  list(
    profile_groups = profile_summary, profile_members = profile_members,
    profile_means = profile_means, trait_groups = trait_groups
  ),
  file.path(out, "profile_clusters.rds")
)
write_workbook(
  list(
    profile_groups = profile_summary, profile_members = profile_members,
    profile_means = profile_means, trait_groups = trait_groups
  ),
  c(
    sprintf(
      "Profile groups: size, mean t, main module, top over-represented set; mean silhouette %.3f.",
      profile_cut$silhouette
    ),
    "Each protein's profile group.",
    "Mean limma t per profile group and screen.",
    "Per trait and window: co-variation groups among p < 0.05 proteins, with silhouette and ORA."
  ),
  file.path(out, "profile_clusters.xlsx"), inputs, paths
)
```
